lead_headline: No new restaurant leads detected today as tracker holds steady at 303 active — reputation jumps 15% week-over-week while subscriptions break even

restaurant.blurb: Zero new leads today — tracker steady at 303 active (161 openings, 142 closures) after Tuesday's quiet. Week remains at 27 openings including Nori Den (Red Lotus), 15 closures including Carmine's, Enzo's.

liquor.blurb: 3 new applications today break Tuesday freeze: Arenna Denver Padel (art gallery permit), Chao & Chen Vietnamese Kitchen (hotel & restaurant), Ace Padel (entertainment) — padel craze claims two of three. 8 status changes led by Colima, Grape Leaf, Tamales by La Casita upgrading from delinquent to active; Himalayan Spice drops to delinquent. Weekly count: 96 — still down 71% from prior week's 333 as post-backlog normalization continues through metro summer doldrums.

reputation.blurb: 4 mentions today led by Recess Beer Garden/Auraria Campus coverage (Denver Post), Platt Park development story, Cherry Creek office redevelopment, parking hearing dismissals. Week climbs to 76 mentions across 13 sources — up 12% from prior week's 68, confirming reversal of three-week slide. Instagram leads at 29, Reddit 13, Denver Post 10, Facebook 9. Week-over-week momentum builds as civic infrastructure stories drive engagement — daily average 10.9 vs. prior period's 9.7. Parking, development, and campus expansion dominate news cycle as summer public interest normalizes.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (8 new, 8 canceled) erases prior day's loss and stabilizes MTD at −43 (−2.0/day). 90-day net holds at +73. Past 14 days show churn ratio stabilizing at 2.8:1 (33 acquisitions vs. 92 cancellations) after mid-July's brutal −12 day. Single-day equilibrium provides brief respite, but July's 22 days still yield 39 new against 82 canceled for sustained −2.0/day bleed rate — nearly triple the YTD's +0.9/day pace. Flat performance interrupts but doesn't reverse month's defection trajectory as Q3 outlook remains challenged.
